items.reason: The year's seizures of Vietnamese and other boats in the North Natuna Sea continue the 2020 arrests (ev-57d6723d07, prev-run candidate) at the same level; a higher count tracks more intrusions. Provisional until 2020 is decided.

State-licensed appraisal drilling in the Tuna block inside the nine-dash line, kept going against China's demands, is a new method against 2020, whose record (prev-run candidates) has no hydrocarbon activity in the contested area.
The diplomatic reply refusing China's demand to halt drilling is the declarative side of the Tuna block drilling (ev-42478fa105).

Four months of Bakamla and Navy ships guarding the rig and pursuing CCG ships protect the Tuna drilling (ev-42478fa105); same move, which this makes coercive. If split off, it is a frequency step on 2020's three-day shadowing of CCG 5204 (ev-63d7872263, prev-run candidate).
Shadowing Haiyang Dizhi 10 while it surveyed the shelf near the Tuna block is part of the same 2021 Tuna standoff (ev-42478fa105).

Keeping at least three warships in the North Natuna Sea under Operation Siaga Segara continues the 2020 naval presence there (ev-39f2da0c71, prev-run candidate, eight warships in January) at no higher level; the trigger partly involved US ships.
A ministerial tour of the Natunas aboard a warship continues the 2020 senior visits to Natuna (ev-9a0f9944d1, the President's) at a lower level; nothing new in method.
The 2022 seizures of Vietnamese boats continue the 2021 practice (ev-4610eaed84), at a lower rate; a coder may add a diminished note.

A presidential spatial-planning regulation zoning defence areas and fishing grounds out to the 200-mile EEZ is a new legal-administrative method against 2021, which has no regulation or administrative act over the waters (nothing comparable among the 2021 candidates).
Sending a corvette and a patrol aircraft to the North Natuna Sea continues the 2021 standing naval patrols there (ev-9c9a8bcede) at a lower level; the trigger was a Chinese-Australian incident.
The 2023 seizures of Vietnamese boats continue the 2022 practice (ev-ed50c6b9db) at about the same level.

Approving the first development plan for the Tuna gas field, with the Navy to secure it as an 'affirmation of sovereignty', is a new step against 2022, which has no energy activity in the contested area (nothing comparable among the 2022 candidates); the 2021 drilling (ev-42478fa105) was appraisal, and its absence in 2022 makes resource development new again.

Deploying a warship, aircraft and a drone to monitor CCG 5901 continues 2022's warship-and-aircraft deployment to the North Natuna Sea (ev-8a99f7b256) by the same method. Least sure: monitoring a CCG ship near Tuna was absent in 2022, so a coder may treat it as new again against 2021's escort of the rig (ev-b7895e69d6).

Saying any line and claim 'must be in accordance with UNCLOS' does not name or reject China's map or assert Indonesia's own rights, close to a call to comply with international law — likely reject; a formal protest note or an explicit rejection of the 2023 map would settle it.

The 2024 seizures of Vietnamese boats continue the 2023 practice (ev-23d91fb5b9) at a lower count. Warning shots on 4 May are not on the 2023 record; if 2023's seizures used none, a coder may call the method new again.
Completing a seizure despite a Vietnamese coast guard vessel's request continues the 2023 seizure practice (ev-23d91fb5b9); the encounter is Vietnam's act, and Indonesia's method did not change.

Driving CCG 5402 out of the North Natuna Sea three times in five days and publicising each expulsion is a change of method against 2023, when Indonesia only monitored CCG 5901 near the Tuna block (ev-6a6c38585b).

Pertamina's Arwana seismic survey of the D-Alpha field is the activity the expulsions protected (ev-172c2ceb83); one linked move. On its own it would be a scope step on 2023's Tuna development (ev-e75b9338a8), to a new block northeast of Natuna.

The statement that the joint statement does not recognise the nine-dash line restates Indonesia's standing non-recognition, voiced in 2023 (ev-89a7c2dcf9); one more reaffirmation is continuation, and it qualifies a cooperative act.
Sugiono's statement to the DPR repeats the same non-recognition line as ev-59bb4f8410; continuation of the reaffirmations on the 2023 record (ev-89a7c2dcf9).
Five Vietnamese boats seized in 2025 against three in 2024 (ev-1873f7e15f) is more of the same arrests as more boats came; the counterfactual makes it continuation.
Pertamina's seismic survey of the East Natuna block continues its 2024 seismic work on the D-Alpha field in the same area (ev-635f4bebfd), same method and area.
The Speaker's call to treat foreign fishing as a sovereignty violation repeats the 2024 parliamentary-level sovereignty statements (ev-a9b24bbd02); no new form or wider claim.

Announcing a Type A air base and a permanent Marine force in Natuna is a new garrison build-up against 2024, which has no military infrastructure or garrison act (nothing comparable among the 2024 candidates).

Live-fire with Starstreak and Astros under the new Kodam XIX is the same 2025 strengthening of the Natuna garrison as ev-7d18b123c8. Least sure: it may be routine unit training, and 2024 has no exercise to compare it with.
Licensing the Arwana III block continues the 2025 resource development inside the nine-dash line (ev-8af5e8fd2b, East Natuna seismic and rig contracting) by the same administrative means.
Resumed Tuna development under a new foreign partner continues state-licensed gas development in the contested shelf (ev-8af5e8fd2b); no new Indonesian government act is reported.

An order to one warship to step up sector patrols, finding no foreign vessels, looks like routine North Natuna patrolling; the 2025 record has no patrol candidate to compare it with. The Fleet Command I patrol pattern for 2025 would settle whether this is continuation.

Building ten patrol vessels and expanding the Batam pier is an announced capacity plan, not yet an act in the area; 2025 has the military garrison build-up (ev-7d18b123c8) but nothing on fisheries enforcement capacity. Their deployment to the North Natuna Sea would settle it.
Awarding the D-Alpha exploration contract continues the 2025 resource development of the same East Natuna area (ev-8af5e8fd2b) by administrative means; who received it does not change the method.
